snippet.title: Deadtime Defenders - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Deadtime Defenders is an addictive side-scrolling looter shooter with RPG elements. Acquire legendary loot, level up your custom character, complete bounties, and fight back against monsters that have invaded Earth!

Available now in Early Access!

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148700/Deadtime_Defenders/
